The Arnot & Gobas (2006) supplementary database obtained on 2026-10-08 (a06-005.xls, SHA-256 d5f642bdaf3c69fa1cf5de3679a5f6d5ed920d8ca68cc8bd86aaece87dc7f8f0) codes ENDPOINT CATEGORY as 1 = field BAF, 2 = BCF from total water concentrations, 3 = BCFfd from freely dissolved concentrations and 4 = modelled BAF, and step (3) of approach 1 in v1 did not say whether BCFfd counts as a fish BCF. Before any record selection, fit or sample, the user chose to keep category 2 only: it is the BCF definition used by the fits H1 is compared with (Veith 1979, Mackay 1982, Isnard & Lambert 1988, Meylan 1999) and it avoids counting one test twice when both a BCF and a BCFfd were derived from it. Only the file's schema and per-category row counts (1: 1295, 2: 5206, 3: 82, 4: 390) were inspected; no BCF-log Kow relationship and no filtered count was computed. Hypotheses, decision rules, guard fields and novelty flags are unchanged, so no literature re-search is needed.
